faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions

q1.question: How do I get started with IOES?
q1.answer: After creating an account, you can explore free courses in the "Courses" section. When you are ready, pick the right course and click "Enroll" to begin your learning journey.

q2.question: Can I try a course for free before enrolling?
q2.answer: Yes. Most courses offer the first 2-3 lessons for free. You can also join "Open" courses published by instructors without enrollment.

q3.question: How recognized are IOES certificates?
q3.answer: Our certificates are verified using blockchain technology and are publicly verifiable. Many IOES enterprise partners recognize these certificates in their hiring and employee evaluation processes.

q4.question: I forgot my password — what should I do?
q4.answer: Click the "Forgot password" link on the login page and follow the instructions. A recovery email will be sent to your registered address within 1-2 minutes.

q5.question: Is payment secure?
q5.answer: All transactions are processed through PCI-DSS certified payment gateways. IOES does not store your card information. We support VNPay, MoMo, international cards and bank transfers.

q6.question: Can I learn on mobile devices?
q6.answer: Yes. The IOES web interface is responsive on every device. You can also install our PWA for a smoother experience and offline learning.

q7.question: How can I become an instructor?
q7.answer: You need at least 3 years of professional experience or a relevant degree, plus the completion of our "Train the Trainer" course. After submitting your application, our team will respond within 5-7 business days.

q8.question: How does exam proctoring work?
q8.answer: We combine AI Computer Vision with human proctors. All unusual behavior is recorded and reported. Learners who violate rules receive warnings or have their results invalidated according to policy.

q9.question: Can I request a VAT invoice?
q9.answer: Yes. After a successful payment, go to "Payment history" and select "Request invoice". Please provide your full company details and tax ID. The invoice will be emailed within 24 hours.

q10.question: How do I contact technical support?
q10.answer: Email support@ioes.edu.vn, call our hotline 1900 5678 (24/7), or use the chat widget at the bottom-right corner. Our technical team is always ready to help.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data in accordance with GDPR, Vietnam's PDPA and international standards.

s1.heading: Information we collect
s1.body1: We collect information you provide directly when registering, enrolling in courses or using IOES services, including name, email, phone number, date of birth, avatar, organization details (if any) and exam content.
s1.body2: In addition, we automatically gather technical data such as IP address, browser type, device, operating system and activity logs to ensure security and improve service quality. Cookies and similar technologies are used according to our dedicated Cookie Policy.

s2.heading: How we use your information
s2.body1: Your information is used to operate the platform, process enrollments and payments, perform auto-grading, provide technical support, send important notifications and improve user experience through anonymous analytics.
s2.body2: We DO NOT sell your personal data to any third party under any circumstance. Every processing activity has a clear legal basis under Article 6 GDPR and Article 11 of Vietnam's PDPA.

s3.heading: Sharing data with third parties
s3.body1: We only share data with trusted partners within the necessary scope, including payment gateways (VNPay, MoMo, Stripe), cloud hosting providers (AWS Singapore) and analytics tools (Google Analytics in anonymized mode).
s3.body2: All partners have signed a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with GDPR. The current partner list is published on our Trust Center and updated every quarter.

s4.heading: Rights of EU users (GDPR)
s4.body1: If you are in the European Economic Area (EEA), you have the following rights under GDPR: Right of access (Art. 15), Right to rectification (Art. 16), Right to erasure (Art. 17), Right to restriction (Art. 18), Right to data portability (Art. 20) and Right to object (Art. 21).
s4.body2: To exercise these rights, please submit a request to privacy@ioes.edu.vn. We will respond within 30 days. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.

s5.heading: Rights of users in Vietnam (PDPA)
s5.body1: Under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection, users in Vietnam have the right to be informed, the right to consent, the right to access, the right to delete or restrict processing and the right to complain.
s5.body2: You may request a review, update or deletion of your personal data at any time through Account Settings or by contacting our DPO. We respect your rights and will handle requests within 72 hours.

s6.heading: Cookies and tracking technologies
s6.body1: IOES uses essential cookies (to maintain login sessions), performance cookies (anonymous analytics) and functional cookies (language and theme preferences). We DO NOT use third-party advertising cookies.
s6.body2: You can manage cookies in Settings > Privacy or via your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect your experience on the platform.

s7.heading: Data retention and deletion
s7.body1: Account data is stored for the duration of your use of the service and up to 24 months after your last activity. Exam and certificate data is stored permanently on the blockchain to ensure public verifiability.
s7.body2: After an account is deleted, personal data is removed from production systems within 30 days, except for records required by law (tax, accounting) which are kept for the legally mandated period.

s8.heading: Contact our DPO
s8.body1: IOES's Data Protection Officer can be reached via email dpo@ioes.edu.vn or by post at: Floor 15, ABC Tower, 123 Nguyen Hue, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
s8.body2: We encourage you to contact the DPO before filing a formal complaint. In most cases, we can resolve the issue within 7 business days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing and using the IOES platform, you agree to comply with the terms below. Please read them carefully before using the service.

s1.heading: Acceptance of terms
s1.body1: When you create an account or use any IOES service, you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these Terms, together with our Privacy Policy and any supplementary terms that apply to specific services.
s1.body2: If you do not agree with any of these terms, please discontinue use of the service immediately. We reserve the right to refuse service to any individual or organization that violates these terms.

s2.heading: Account responsibilities
s2.body1: You are solely responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and all activity that occurs under your account. Please notify us immediately if you detect any unauthorized access. IOES is not liable for losses arising from unauthorized use of your account.
s2.body2: You must provide accurate, complete and up-to-date information during registration. Identity fraud, multi-accounting or promotion abuse are considered serious violations.

s3.heading: Course access
s3.body1: After a successful payment, you are granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable access right to the course content for the period stated on your enrollment. Access is for your personal use only and must not be shared under any circumstances.
s3.body2: Some courses may have time-limited access or prerequisite requirements. Logging in simultaneously from many devices may be limited according to our anti-fraud policy.

s4.heading: Payment and refunds
s4.body1: All course prices include VAT (where applicable). We accept payments via VNPay, MoMo, international credit cards and bank transfer. Refund requests must be submitted within 7 days of enrollment and the learner must not have completed more than 20% of the course content.
s4.body2: In the event IOES cancels a course due to technical or content reasons, we commit to refunding 100% of the tuition within 14 business days. Recurring subscriptions can be cancelled anytime and remain effective until the end of the paid period.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions

q1.question: How do I get started with IOES?
q1.answer: After creating an account, you can explore free courses in the 'Courses' section. When you are ready, pick the right course and click 'Enroll' to begin your learning journey.

q2.question: Can I try a course for free before enrolling?
q2.answer: Yes. Most courses offer the first 2-3 lessons for free. You can also join 'Open' courses published by instructors without enrollment.

q3.question: How recognized are IOES certificates?
q3.answer: Our certificates are verified using blockchain technology and are publicly verifiable. Many IOES enterprise partners recognize these certificates in their hiring and employee evaluation processes.

q4.question: I forgot my password — what should I do?
q4.answer: Click the 'Forgot password' link on the login page and follow the instructions. A recovery email will be sent to your registered address within 1-2 minutes.

q5.question: Is payment secure?
q5.answer: All transactions are processed through PCI-DSS certified payment gateways. IOES does not store your card information. We support VNPay, MoMo, international cards and bank transfers.

q6.question: Can I learn on mobile devices?
q6.answer: Yes. The IOES web interface is responsive on every device. You can also install our PWA for a smoother experience and offline learning.

q7.question: How can I become an instructor?
q7.answer: You need at least 3 years of professional experience or a relevant degree, plus the completion of our 'Train the Trainer' course. After submitting your application, our team will respond within 5-7 business days.

q8.question: How does exam proctoring work?
q8.answer: We combine AI Computer Vision with human proctors. All unusual behavior is recorded and reported. Learners who violate rules receive warnings or have their results invalidated according to policy.

q9.question: Can I request a VAT invoice?
q9.answer: Yes. After a successful payment, go to 'Payment history' and select 'Request invoice'. Please provide your full company details and tax ID. The invoice will be emailed within 24 hours.

q10.question: How do I contact technical support?
q10.answer: Email support@ioes.edu.vn, call our hotline 1900 5678 (24/7), or use the chat widget at the bottom-right corner. Our technical team is always ready to help.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data in accordance with GDPR, Vietnam's PDPA and international standards.

s1.heading: Information we collect
s1.body1: We collect information you provide directly when registering, enrolling in courses or using IOES services, including name, email, phone number, date of birth, avatar, organization details (if any) and exam content.
s1.body2: In addition, we automatically gather technical data such as IP address, browser type, device, operating system and activity logs to ensure security and improve service quality. Cookies and similar technologies are used according to our dedicated Cookie Policy.

s2.heading: How we use your information
s2.body1: Your information is used to operate the platform, process enrollments and payments, perform auto-grading, provide technical support, send important notifications and improve user experience through anonymous analytics.
s2.body2: We DO NOT sell your personal data to any third party under any circumstance. Every processing activity has a clear legal basis under Article 6 GDPR and Article 11 of Vietnam's PDPA.

s3.heading: Sharing data with third parties
s3.body1: We only share data with trusted partners within the necessary scope, including payment gateways (VNPay, MoMo, Stripe), cloud hosting providers (AWS Singapore) and analytics tools (Google Analytics in anonymized mode).
s3.body2: All partners have signed a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with GDPR. The current partner list is published on our Trust Center and updated every quarter.

s4.heading: Rights of EU users (GDPR)
s4.body1: If you are in the European Economic Area (EEA), you have the following rights under GDPR: Right of access (Art. 15), Right to rectification (Art. 16), Right to erasure (Art. 17), Right to restriction (Art. 18), Right to data portability (Art. 20) and Right to object (Art. 21).
s4.body2: To exercise these rights, please submit a request to privacy@ioes.edu.vn. We will respond within 30 days. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.

s5.heading: Rights of users in Vietnam (PDPA)
s5.body1: Under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection, users in Vietnam have the right to be informed, the right to consent, the right to access, the right to delete or restrict processing and the right to complain.
s5.body2: You may request a review, update or deletion of your personal data at any time through Account Settings or by contacting our DPO. We respect your rights and will handle requests within 72 hours.

s6.heading: Cookies and tracking technologies
s6.body1: IOES uses essential cookies (to maintain login sessions), performance cookies (anonymous analytics) and functional cookies (language and theme preferences). We DO NOT use third-party advertising cookies.
s6.body2: You can manage cookies in Settings > Privacy or via your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect your experience on the platform.

s7.heading: Data retention and deletion
s7.body1: Account data is stored for the duration of your use of the service and up to 24 months after your last activity. Exam and certificate data is stored permanently on the blockchain to ensure public verifiability.
s7.body2: After an account is deleted, personal data is removed from production systems within 30 days, except for records required by law (tax, accounting) which are kept for the legally mandated period.

s8.heading: Contact our DPO
s8.body1: IOES's Data Protection Officer can be reached via email dpo@ioes.edu.vn or by post at: Floor 15, ABC Tower, 123 Nguyen Hue, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
s8.body2: We encourage you to contact the DPO before filing a formal complaint. In most cases, we can resolve the issue within 7 business days.
